title: LUNAI BIOWORKS, INC. ANNOUNCES REVERSE STOCK SPLIT
summary: Lunai Bioworks, Inc. (Nasdaq: LNAI) (the " Company ") today announced that it will effect a reverse stock split of its issued and outstanding common stock, par value $0.0001 per share (the " Common Stock "), at a ratio of 1-for-8 (the " Reverse Stock Split "). The Reverse Stock Split is expected to become effective at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on May 22, 2026, and the Company's Common Stock is expected to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on The Nasdaq Capital Market at the opening of trading on May 22, 2026, under the existing trading symbol " LNAI ." The Company's Common Stock will trade under a new CUSIP number, 29350E302 following the effectiveness of the Reverse Stock Split.
